steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hyah! Gah!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: (Panting)

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Get down, old man!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Die!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Not you! The beast!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Well, get down! I'm setting off my Originium Arts!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Grab my hand. Are you okay?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What was that? Those beasts went down in the blink of an eye...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Originium Arts using this Arts Unit. My own special trick.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Tch... parlor tricks.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The traps will slow the rest. Leave them to Sumoto's group. We can head over to the other side, where the defenses are thinner... Take it easy, old man.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Cut the crap.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What's with that look on your face?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: No, just thinking back to the days when us hunters fought side by side.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: It's been seven years, and this is the first time you haven't told me to get lost or called me a traitor.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I... I didn't think you would really take up...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Akira's hunting spear. You can say it. I know you were Akira's mentor. You didn't think I would go kill those beasts?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You weren't a hunter at the time, and you objected to Akira becoming one. His sacrifice changed you...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm glad you noticed.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Old man, there's something... Perhaps you've misunderstood all this time, and I wasn't sure how to tell you.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I didn't abandon him to die.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Lure powder.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You knew?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm his father.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That idiot sacrificed himself to protect your mine.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I still remember the look on his face that day, his eyes, his every move...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The cries of the beasts were everywhere. He opened his mouth to say something, but it was drowned out by the noise. I remember his pale lips...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Could he have been saying...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Akira!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Kusso, where did all these beasts come from? What did you do?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Don't tell me you—

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Stay away, master! Don't follow me, no matter what!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Come back! We'll stop them here!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: No, master! You should know better than anyone!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: We can't stop an outbreak like this... many people will be hurt, even killed.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: The Originium mine would be destroyed. Everything you've worked for would be lost. I can't let that happen.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Weren't you against the mine? Just let it burn!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Come back! Your life matters more!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: The beasts are gathering.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Time is short, master.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Yes, I was against the mine. Originium is unknown and dangerous. It will bring disaster we can't even predict.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: I also can't forgive the taking of innocent lives. This was the inevitable result of you failing to respect nature and letting greed take over.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: But I also remember the day we went into the city together and saw the high-rise buildings. The bright lights and shining signs, all made possible by Originium...

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Originium is valuable. It will lift the village out of poverty, become the pillar of our livelihood... We've come this far. Don't let this opportunity go to waste.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Akira!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Wasn't it you who taught me that a hunter must fight for the survival of his clan?

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Out of the way, you damned beasts!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: This beast outbreak is the wrath of nature.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: But I'm also fighting for survival. We stare each other in the eyes as equals.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Promise me one last thing, master.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Lead the others.

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: Survive.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Come back, Akira!

steps.name: Akira Kashiwau
steps.text: And please pass this on to my father, that stubborn old timer.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: He said...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: 'I'm sorry, father.'

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hmph... I've had enough of your tall tale. He never called me father.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That brat...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Argh!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: But I...
Only the old man's back is visible.
But he could hear the sound of water dripping.
Tears that had been forced back for too long, finally overflowing.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I miss him.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Up above!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: That monster... it's coming.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: The beasts are coming again! Chikushou, how could there be so many!

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: We don't have enough hands!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You stay here! Set up those traps and stop the beasts!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: THAT one is mine.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'm a hunter. That's my quarry.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato! Here comes the Rathalos!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I knew it.

steps.name: Palico
steps.text: After our previous encounters, it now sees all humans as a threat.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: It landed near the Kashiwau house, and it's getting closer!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The reinforcements are still pretty far off. Not all the villagers have made it to the shelter either.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: This is the worst possible timing... You oversee the evacuation. I'll—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Over there, Yato! Beasts! I see five of them!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The stampede is coming. The hunters' defenses can't stop all of them. We must protect the evacuating villagers.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What do we do then? Just sit here and wait for the Rathalos? That will only make things worse!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm thinking... We need a way to stop the Rathalos for a while, at least until all the villagers are safe...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Kashiwau...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Kashiwau? But we don't even know where he is. And he's just one man.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I see him, near the hut.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: He's close to the Rathalos! Yato, maybe we should—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We'll have time to complete the evacuation if he can delay it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You mean... we're not helping him?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We just have to trust him.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: (Opens a can of oil)

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You think so too, eh? Today's a good day. The heavens burn red.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So many things have happened lately. A little girl came back all grown up, stirring up all kinds of trouble.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: A firebreathing monster appeared out of nowhere, and two outsiders went in trouble near the forest.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Then beasts came rushing up, their mine blew up, a Catastrophe struck, and they couldn't even run away properly.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: And the funniest part? People keep coming to dig up my past from the mud and rub my face in it.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: They all say it's for my sake, but each shard of it they dig up cuts me open, piece by piece.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Noir Corne had the right idea. The truth isn't important. Let the past stay in the past.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Let the dead stay dead. Burn it all, leave nothing behind.
He hears the sobbing of flames, swallowing up the fragments of the past.
The ashes of time drift before his eyes, burning away the gaze of regret.
Burn.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: This fire is so beautiful.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: You'd have done the same, wouldn't you, Akira?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: I'll take the next step.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hey! Over here!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Even the corners of your jaws are singed. Your scales are full of scars. You big ugly...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: What's that? Sparks from your mouth? Are you angry?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Don't look away. Your enemy's right here.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Look at me. Yes. That's right.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Be angry. Be angrier.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Come on!

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Face me, monster!
